shortDescription: The last stretch of the sole road leading to the Gyirong border crossing into Nepal, torn apart by catastrophic flooding last week, fully reopened on Wednesday, Chinese state broadcaster CCTV said, adding that multiple rescue teams were on site to accelerate the search for missing people.
